title: Isolate Prokaryotes from Sponge Tissue
author: Martin Thomas Jahn
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.u8vezw6
materials: Thoroughly resuspend fixed cells in 500 µl PBS

steps.title: Homogenize sponge tissue on ice
steps.instruction: Mince sponge tissue in ice‑cold CMASW with a razor blade in a petri dish on ice (use tissue volume that fits in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube), then squeeze remaining pieces with a 15 mL Falcon tube lid on ice, and vortex the suspension strongly for 5 min at 21 °C.

steps.title: Dilute homogenate and incubate on ice
steps.instruction: Transfer the homogenate to a fresh 50 mL Falcon tube, add CMASW up to a total volume of 20 mL, and incubate on ice for 30 min.

steps.title: Filter through 40 µm cell strainer
steps.instruction: Pass the incubated suspension through a Corning 40 µm cell strainer (Catalog #431750) into a fresh 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Wash filtrate with CMASW
steps.instruction: Transfer the filtrate to another fresh 50 mL Falcon tube and add CMASW up to 50 mL.

steps.title: Centrifuge at 600 g, collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Spin the tube at 600 g for 10 min at 4 °C; keep the supernatant (contains the bacterial fraction).

steps.title: Centrifuge at 1600 g and resuspend
steps.instruction: Spin the remaining pellet at 1600 g for 10 min at 4 °C and resuspend the pellet in 50 mL CMASW.

steps.title: Repeat wash until solution clear
steps.instruction: Repeat the transfer of supernatant to a fresh 50 mL Falcon tube, add CMASW up to 50 mL, and centrifuge at 600 g for 10 min at 4 °C until the solution becomes clear (removing secondary metabolites).

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in cold 1 % PFA
steps.instruction: When the solution is clear, resuspend the pellet in 1 mL ice‑cold 1 % (mass) PFA prepared in CMASW and transfer the suspension to a fresh 2 mL tube (final fixation concentration 4 % PFA).

steps.title: Fix overnight at 4 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube overnight at 4 °C in a refrigerator.

steps.title: Pellet cells at 4000 g
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the fixed cells for 10 min at 4000 × g, then discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Repeat dilution and incubation
steps.instruction: Transfer the pellet to a fresh 50 mL Falcon tube, add CMASW up to 20 mL, and incubate on ice for 30 min.

steps.title: Add ethanol and resuspend
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL absolute ethanol to the pellet and resuspend the cells thoroughly.

steps.title: Store suspension at –20 °C
steps.instruction: Store the final cell suspension at –20 °C; it remains stable for several months.
